Use TradeHQ to practise USD/TRY forex trading with virtual funds. The goal is to learn order mechanics, position sizing and how volatility affects a practice portfolio — not to predict the next move or prepare for a specific real-money trade.

answers.answer: No. Every USD/TRY trade on TradeHQ uses virtual currency only — no real funds are ever at risk. The platform is designed purely for education and skill-building.
